notes: Wave 2: Weather tool (snow that can freeze Gloop solid, heat waves that make it droopy and sweaty, wind). Item reactions: snow freezes goo into ice, lightning or the zapper electrifies goo, firecrackers next to crates make crate bombs, black holes eat items and burp. Three new games: Hide and Seek, Copy Me and Bounce Tower. A daily challenge worth 60 coins, and 6 new trophies.
